title: BusinessAssessment
description: Moat and business quality. Every claim must point at a number in the snapshot or a passage in the filings extract; unevidenced moat language is rejected at review.

business_model.description: How the company actually earns money, in concrete terms. Segment names and their share of revenue, not category labels.

evidence_in_numbers.description: A moat that is real shows up in margins, ROIC, or pricing. Cite the metric and the trend.

counter_evidence.description: What in the numbers argues against the moat. Required field; write 'none found' only after looking.

capital_allocation.description: What management has actually done with cash over the last 3 years, and whether it created value.
